function.name: update_intake
function.description: Required after a caller provides or corrects intake facts, BEFORE the next question. Save initial job and confirmed caller name immediately, not only address details. Backend automatically queues membership after a complete eligible address and name are confirmed. Saves risk immediately. One tool at a time using the latest revision. Gas safety guidance must precede this tool. Does not book or notify.

expected_revision.description: 0 for the first update; otherwise use state.revision from the latest tool result.

caller_quote.description: Short quote of what the caller actually said supporting these changes. Never invent a quote.

service_address.description: Street number and street name only. Save apartment/unit and ZIP separately. Do not guess or silently change the address.

address_confirmed.description: True only after a separate explicit confirmation of saved street, unit, city, state and ZIP. Do not change address components in this update.

service_type.description: Classify the requested service; maintenance can still reveal an urgent risk.

heating_unavailable.description: Caller reports loss of heat. Use unknown if explicitly uncertain; omit if not discussed.

cooling_unavailable.description: Caller reports AC not producing cooling, including not turning on. Use unknown if explicitly uncertain; omit if not discussed.

cold_conditions_reported.description: Caller reports cold or winter conditions relevant to the loss of heat. Do not infer weather solely from the date. Use unknown if explicitly uncertain; omit if not discussed.

vulnerable_resident.description: Caller reports an elderly resident or a health vulnerability to loss of cooling. Do not collect diagnosis details. Use unknown if explicitly uncertain; omit if not discussed.

gas_smell_reported.description: True for any current suspected gas smell/leak reported by the caller, including faint or uncertain suspected smells. False only for an explicit denial/correction; unknown only when no suspected incident is established. Do not mark true for a hypothetical question or a mention of gas equipment. Give immediate safety guidance before saving.

service_unit.description: Caller-supplied apartment/unit. Save none only if the caller explicitly says there is no unit; do not infer it from silence.

service_zip.description: Five-digit ZIP supplied by the caller; never infer from caller ID or a candidate account.

membership_claim.description: Caller says they have an active maintenance plan (true), explicitly says they do not (false), or is unsure (unknown). This is a claim, not the database membership result. Omit if not discussed.

service_city.description: Caller-supplied fact; do not invent. Optional notes must not delay urgent handling.

issue_duration.description: Caller-supplied fact; do not invent. Optional notes must not delay urgent handling.

equipment_notes.description: Caller-supplied fact; do not invent. Optional notes must not delay urgent handling.

access_notes.description: Caller-supplied fact; do not invent. Optional notes must not delay urgent handling.

onsite_contact.description: Caller-supplied fact; do not invent. Optional notes must not delay urgent handling.

callback_number.description: Caller-provided callback in E.164. Separate from caller ID and account phone. Ask rather than guess.

callback_confirmed.description: True only for a separate explicit confirmation of the already saved callback; never with a changed callback.

preferred_date.description: Requested date in America/New_York; ask to clarify ambiguous dates.

changes.description: Only changed facts. Omit unchanged or undiscussed fields; use unknown for explicitly uncertain risk facts. Do not send nulls.

confirmation_address.description: Required when address_confirmed is true. Copy the exact service_address from the current saved state.
